item.title: Queen Mary 2 reunites with original Queen Mary after 20 years
item.description: Cunard has marked a rare milestone as Queen Mary 2 has reunited with her legendary predecessor Queen Mary for the first time in 20 years.

item.title: Hindenburg airship flew low over Southampton with swastikas on its tail fins
item.description: . It was an unavoidably real, uncannily surreal moment, as the pride of Nazi engineering met the historic port of the British Empire.

item.title: 'Too poor to wed' - Magistrates overrule father’s objection musician’s marriage
item.description: True love, they say, never runs smooth and they were forced to resort to the local magistrates for permission to marry after his father had objected.

item.title: NHS nurse struck-off after taking drugs with former patient
item.description: A Hampshire mental health nurse has been struck-off after consuming cannabis and ecstasy with a former in-patient at a mental health unit.

item.title: Meet the smooth-talking Dr Death who eluded police across the south for three months
item.description: While serving a ten year stretch, Dr Death - in reality Sidney Duncan Noble - escaped from an East Sussex prison.

item.title: Flood rescues hit record highs as crews respond to 24 incidents in one month
item.description: Fire crews faced a dramatic rise in flood callouts last month, making January 2026 the busiest month on record for rescues from floodwater.

item.title: Warning issued as Lymington scammers hijack Mayor’s name in £500 prize con
item.description: A brazen scam using the name of a town’s mayor has left one resident nearly £500 out of pocket — prompting a stark warning from a councillor.

item.title: Shipping container removed from Romsey land after 19-month legal battle
item.description: A large container placed on protected land in Romsey has finally been removed following a lengthy enforcement battle.

item.title: Woman sex offender jailed for not telling police address after prison release
item.description: A woman sex offender has been jailed for not registering with a police station after being released.
